en-US: Desktop sync issues can now open a prefilled GitHub report with diagnostics, making failures easier to report and resolve.
Workspace shortcuts now provide a single, predictable home for plugin actions, while duplicate Marketplace and AI prompt entries have been removed.
The editor now recovers from stalled browser storage, preserves an emergency draft, and offers retry or copy actions instead of leaving saves stuck.
Large sync batches now fetch change details in bounded groups, preventing bulk imports and other high-volume updates from failing at query limits.
zh-CN: 桌面端同步问题现在可直接打开预填诊断信息的 GitHub 报告，便于反馈和排查故障。
工作区快捷入口现在集中承载插件操作，并移除了重复的插件市场与 AI 提示词入口。
编辑器现在可从浏览器本地存储卡顿中恢复，保留应急草稿并提供重试或复制操作，避免保存一直停滞。
大批量同步现在会分组获取变更详情，避免批量导入等高频更新因查询数量限制而失败。
